Maine is likely to be the tipping point in the race for the Senate majority. That makes it one of the most important contests anywhere in 2026, and it means the people of Maine are about to make a choice that will shape what happens in Washington for years to come.

Troy Jackson’s record shows that he is working for the people of Maine. As a state legislator, he worked to lower prescription drug prices and protect good-paying union jobs for families across Maine. Those aren't positions he picked up for some campaign purpose. They reflect decades of putting Maine families first, and that's the clearest signal of how he’ll serve in the Senate.

Susan Collins’ record over 30 years points in a different direction. She voted to confirm the Supreme Court justices who overturned Roe v. Wade and gutted the Voting Rights Act. She voted to enable cuts to Medicaid. She voted to give tax breaks to the top 1%. Each of those votes had real consequences for people in Maine, and together they show whose interests she’s chosen to serve.

body:
Another big day on the campaign trail...

https://secure.anedot.com/andyfornevada/email-launch

Dear
Peter,
This past week, I had the pleasure of joining guest host Sam Peters on The Wayne Allyn Root show to discuss my campaign for Assembly District 37.

We covered a lot of ground during the interview, including the coming fight over tax increases, the Democrats’ dangerous attacks on our brave men and women in law enforcement and how they’re undermining our public safety, and the importance of rebuilding Nevada’s economy in a way that promotes economic liberty and prosperity.

Above all, we talked about what’s at stake this November — the competing visions between myself and my left-wing opponent, and why winning this race is so important to breaking the Democrats’ stranglehold on our state legislature.

I hope you’ll click below to take a listen ... and as always, I’d love any feedback or comments you’d like to provide!
https://andyfornevada.com/andy-matthews_sam-peters_8-28-20/
***

By the way, I was also honored this week to receive the endorsement of the National Rifle Association. I’ve long been a proud champion of the Second Amendment, and it’s an absolute thrill to have the support of our nation’s preeminent defender of the right to bear arms.

Especially today, with Nevada’s Democrats waging a relentless assault on our Second Amendment rights (for her part, my opponent received an “F” grade from the NRA), it’s more important than ever that we elect those who will unapologetically defend our Constitution. And you can count on me to do exactly that in Carson City.

For Nevada’s future,

Andy

# [Thank you, Governor Shapiro!](https://bethfarnhamforcongress.com/2026/10/18/thank-you-governor-shapiro/?jetpack_skip_subscription_popup)
---
By **Elizabeth Farnham** on October 18, 2026
---
| **District Round-up 10.18.26**
---
Dear Neighbor, Thank you for reading my District Round-up. As your candidate for Pennsylvania’s 13th Congressional District, it is my honor and pleasure to deliver to you where I’ve been and what issues I’ve tackled in the past week. Criss-crossing the counties of Adams, Franklin, Fulton, Bedford, Cambria, Blair, Huntingdon, Mifflin, Juniata, Perry, Cumberland, and Somerset gives me great opportunities to meet with voters, hear what is on your hearts and minds, and the chance to voice my fight for Everyday Americans. If you would like to contribute to my campaign, please donate here:**[https://secure.actblue.com/donate/beth-farnham-for-congress-1](http://bethfarnhamforcongress.com?action=user_content_redirect&uuid=0b9bba863b89cac46d85c649843a6d0ec5c9133ce1e1e5e4f98615c7ac50439f&blog_id=213069660&post_id=9339&user_id=248418217&subs_id=487468588&signature=569194bb97f9eb8092b1a07e6cfdbaac&email_name=new-post&user_email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&encoded_url=aHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmUuYWN0Ymx1ZS5jb20vZG9uYXRlL2JldGgtZmFybmhhbS1mb3ItY29uZ3Jlc3MtMQ=&email_id=5e728273f3417cd735a94e8a84bfff93)**
---
| **Governor Shapiro Stumps in Johnstown**
---
| |
---
Many thanks to Governor Shapiro for stumping in Johnstown!
---
This election is critical and re-electing our caring governor is important to protect our state from the overreaches of the current and criminal presidential administration.
---
Governor Shapiro has my support and our 13th Congressional District has his.
---
In fact, one of the reasons I support him is for taking the line out of the state budget for grants to religiously-founded crisis pregnancy centers. These dens of iniquity are generally not licensed healthcare centers. Instead, they’re places where church people in scrubs actively deter vulnerable pregant women from seeking abortion, using “deceptive counseling” and unregulated medical equipment. I also appreciate his advocacy for victims of sex abuse when he was Attorney General.
---
I also support him for opposing the Trump administration on their illegal requests for SNAP beneficiary information and voter intimidation.
---
Please vote for me, Beth Farnham, for Congress and for Josh Shapiro for Governor on November 3rd.
---
Together, we #ChooseDemocracy !
---
[Gov. Josh Shapiro has sued the Trump admin dozens of times. Here’s everything to know about those lawsuits.](http://bethfarnhamforcongress.com?action=user_content_redirect&uuid=e08cfc83ba46301f2cf98e85d688c56c8c6ffb05f48d0bf396577ba4849c01a0&blog_id=213069660&post_id=9339&user_id=248418217&subs_id=487468588&signature=a5715356486a05349732ad3649822908&email_name=new-post&user_email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&encoded_&email_id=5e728273f3417cd735a94e8a84bfff93)

| **Farnham for Ukraine**
---
| |
---
While our incompetent and corrupt U.S. President may have betrayed his agreement to help Ukraine by (allegedly) hampering its connectivity to Starlink, as Elon Musk blameshifts, I stand with President Zelenskyy and the Ukrainian people to defend themselves against Russian aggression.
---
“Ukraine was blindsided by new limits placed on satellite connectivity inside the country that handicapped its ability to use military drones and defend against Russian attacks.
---
After bipartisan backlash on Wednesday, Elon Musk said it was the U.S., not his company SpaceX that provides the systems, that made the call.
---
The limits affected both the Starlink satellite connections, used for civilian and defensive activities, as well as Starshield, the version designed for government and military use for both defensive and offensive capabilities.”
---
Furthermore, I support Ukraine’s recent attack on the Russian data center that may have compromised bots that were working in favor of conservative candidates ahead of the election. I hope Ukraine gets them all.
---
Lastly, I support the increased sanctions against Russia by the European Union.
---
“Today the EU adopted the largest round of sanctions listings since 2022. Close to 1600 listings target Russia’s military-industrial complex. Over half address the production chain for the ballistic missiles Russia uses to kill Ukrainian civilians every day. Bombing Kyiv’s bridges, ships transporting grain, and the National Academy of Sciences are not the actions of a country seeking peace. This is not the time to ease pressure on Moscow but to increase it.”
---
Meanwhile, Trump has made a deal with Putin to buy deisel fuel from Russia.
---
“Last week, Trump announced via social media he had struck a deal with Putin, whereby Russia will supply more than 300,000 tons of diesel to the American and global market, followed by an additional 500,000 tons in November and one million tons “immediately thereafter.””
---
Of course, our own U.S. Representative in Congress, out-of-touch John Joyce, silently approves of making deals with Putin in the face of Ukraine suffering.
---
In 2024, Joyce even voted against a $60 billion military aid package for Ukraine that passed the House.
---
But it doesn’t have to be this way.
---
We can be represented in Congress by someone who actually cares about our allies and recognizes that Russia is an enemy at this time.
---
Vote for me, Beth Farnham, on November 3rd, so we can stop this nonsense and be fully the ally for Ukraine we always were supposed to be.
---
Together, we #ChooseDemocracy and actual allyship!
---

---
Oct. 14, 2026, 7:54 PM EDT
---
[Ukraine](http://bethfarnhamforcongress.com?action=user_content_redirect&uuid=22dd2cc43955820af7f1acfc2243af4d2a13d5ce5790b61533ebcc315edd5340&blog_id=213069660&post_id=9339&user_id=248418217&subs_id=487468588&signature=fcd5ef2f2278ef85e0975cbff3bfc29e&email_name=new-post&user_email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&encoded_url=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cubXMubm93L25ld3MvdHJ1bXAtemVsZW5za3l5LXJ1c3NpYS1kaWVzZWwtaXJhbi13YXItZWxlY3Rpb24&email_id=5e728273f3417cd735a94e8a84bfff93) was blindsided by new limits placed on satellite connectivity inside the country that handicapped its ability to use military drones and defend against Russian attacks.
---
After bipartisan backlash on Wednesday, Elon Musk said it was the U.S., not his company SpaceX that provides the systems, that made the call.
---
The limits affected both the Starlink satellite connections, used for civilian and defensive activities, as well as Starshield, the version designed for government and military use for both defensive and offensive capabilities.
---
On Tuesday night, Ukraine discovered that neither system could connect to data from objects — like satellite-controlled defensive and offensive drones — traveling more than 100 miles per hour, a source familiar with the actions told MS NOW on the condition of anonymity to discuss sensitive military operations.
---
Serhii Beskrestnov, Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy’s defense technology adviser, [confirmed overnight](http://bethfarnhamforcongress.com?action=user_content_redirect&uuid=1a996f882838536b41a09b37daf9e224093c927948d698ef7d63235bb8992983&blog_id=213069660&post_id=9339&user_id=248418217&subs_id=487468588&signature=54b41364afa0deed12ce3afafe0ad6a1&email_name=new-post&user_email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&encoded_url=aHR0cHM6Ly90Lm1lL3NlcmhpaV9mbGFzaC83ODA2&email_id=5e728273f3417cd735a94e8a84bfff93) that the speed limit for use of Starshield services “resulted in the disruption of several missions.”
---
“It is clear that this action is not coincidental and is related to the current political situation,” Beskrestnov wrote.
---
The Starshield connections are “critical for Ukraine’s defense,” Ukrainian Defense Minister Mykhailo Fedorov [wrote Wednesday on X](http://bethfarnhamforcongress.com?action=user_content_redirect&uuid=167b37ba697f24f50717464411fcff79d839d04f97f2dc9f2cd32c327b2a4169&blog_id=213069660&post_id=9339&user_id=248418217&subs_id=487468588&signature=b2fe5e78f223746232ea678a23bbe2d0&email_name=new-post&user_email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&encoded_url=aHR0cHM6Ly94LmNvbS9GZWRvcm92TXlraGFpbG8vc3RhdHVzLzIxMTA0MzIwMzE5Njg1NDI3MjE/cz00NiZ0PVdRc0RZeTBwR2dhRUxVazJjVDhSZ1E&email_id=5e728273f3417cd735a94e8a84bfff93), saying the high-speed use was being restored.
---
Musk said the Starshield satellite connections the Ukraine military relies on are ultimately controlled by President Donald Trump.
---
“Starshield systems are owned and controlled by the US government,” Musk [wrote on X](http://bethfarnhamforcongress.com?action=user_content_redirect&uuid=b69e109ec9becdda138d243d24cc9e907961d9adb7e431fb5e1803fe105545b4&blog_id=213069660&post_id=9339&user_id=248418217&subs_id=487468588&signature=828a19bf386ab8138655e18088aad6ad&email_name=new-post&user_email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&encoded_url=aHR0cHM6Ly94LmNvbS9lbG9ubXVzay9zdGF0dXMvMjExMDQ0NTU3NzE4NDEzMzQ1Ng=&email_id=5e728273f3417cd735a94e8a84bfff93). “Any limits on speed or usage are decided by the US military and ultimately POTUS.”
---
The White House, Pentagon and SpaceX did not respond to MS NOW’s requests for comment.
---
SpaceX provided no prior warning to the Ukrainian government about the limitation, the source said. Ukrainian forces learned about the Starshield speed restrictions from customer support after filing a complaint about operational issues.
---
SpaceX informed Ukrainian officials that the restriction applies to drones and aircraft flying at speeds of 100 mph or higher, but, the source said, military units also reported issues with performance at lower drone speeds.
---
“This makes the operation of UAVs, airplanes and helicopters at high speeds impossible, which will also impact efforts to counter Shahed drones within Ukraine,” the source said, adding the speed restriction affects all defense operations and logistics, giving Russians “a real leverage on the frontline” at a time when Ukraine has effectively stopped their advances.
---
Even Republicans had strong words for both Musk and the Trump administration.
---
“I’m confident this does not reflect a change in SpaceX policy because if so, intentionally degrading Ukraine’s ability to defend itself might be construed as aiding and abetting a mass murderer,” Sen. Thom Tillis, R-S.C., [wrote to Musk on X](http://bethfarnhamforcongress.com?action=user_content_redirect&uuid=4865e2197845e9a470790cf714c07dc1dc87d5e35c4c05a945f1364b6f25beb0&blog_id=213069660&post_id=9339&user_id=248418217&subs_id=487468588&signature=e0ab2c535108889fdd1045641156c383&email_name=new-post&user_email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&encoded_url=aHR0cHM6Ly94LmNvbS9TZW5UaG9tVGlsbGlzL3N0YXR1cy8yMTEwNDI1ODAzODA0NTYxNDYy&email_id=5e728273f3417cd735a94e8a84bfff93), asking him to clarify SpaceX’s position.
---
The timing of the Starshield changes coincides with Ukrainian officials saying the U.S. and allied partners have not been giving them the same amount of early warnings about incoming Russian ballistic missile attacks.
---
Rep. Don Bacon, R-Neb., said Trump’s decision to reduce intelligence sharing with Ukraine and access to Starlink equated to “aiding the invader & the war criminal who bombs cities,” and threatens to reduce congressional support for the Trump administration.
---
“Their agenda is dead unless they change paths,” Bacon [wrote on X](http://bethfarnhamforcongress.com?action=user_content_redirect&uuid=6f6b6a702cfd8b6c93bea5ad04c3314324acfb23c51b70fd9b3f1f0f039ec597&blog_id=213069660&post_id=9339&user_id=248418217&subs_id=487468588&signature=c0280964028b2f6a387bdbd772714519&email_name=new-post&user_email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&encoded_url=aHR0cHM6Ly94LmNvbS9SZXBEb25CYWNvbi9zdGF0dXMvMjExMDM4ODY2MzQwMTk3NTg3NQ=&email_id=5e728273f3417cd735a94e8a84bfff93).
---
Ukraine Caucus Co-Chairs Reps. Marcy Kaptur, D-Ohio; Brian Fitzpatrick, R-Pa.; Mike Quigley, D-Ill.; and Joe Wilson, R-S.C., wrote in a bipartisan statement they were “alarmed” by reports of the U.S. withholding both intelligence and Starlink support, “putting innocent civilians and American citizens in Ukraine at the mercy of Russian attacks.”
---
“U.S. allies pay for Ukraine’s access to Starlink,” the lawmakers wrote. “Restrictions that put civilians in harm’s way are unconscionable and will not be accepted by Congress.”
---
The source familiar with Ukrainian forces’ use of Starshield confirmed to MS NOW that the signal was improving as of Wednesday afternoon, but only slightly. “The situation is better than before, but it is still not good enough, and the service has not returned to its previous level,” the source said.
---
Ukraine is seeking to restore its unlimited access regardless of speed, which was part of the current service agreement contracted through the U.S. government. The agreement has been in place since November 2025 and is expected to remain in effect through May 2027.
---
As SpaceX reduced Starshield connectivity for Ukraine overnight, Russia targeted critical energy infrastructure in the Kyiv and Kharkiv regions in a deadly ballistic missile strike.
---
Earlier this week, Trump denied withholding intelligence essential for Ukraine’s defenses after multiple threats against Ukraine if it failed to halt attacks on Russian oil refineries — even as Russia has flouted the so-called energy ceasefire announced by the president.
---
Rep. Jim Himes, the top Democrat on the House Intelligence Committee, said in a statement that the committee “has received no notification of any change in posture with respect to intelligence support to Ukraine.”
---
Zelenskyy said in an interview Wednesday that he felt betrayed by Trump’s diesel deal with Russian President Vladimir Putin, announced last week, and that his immediate response was that Ukraine is “losing a strong partner” in America.
---
“We can’t be weak, otherwise we can’t survive,” he told Piers Morgan. “That’s why it’s painful when President Trump chooses one side — not our side.”
---
Zelenskyy criticized people around Trump for giving the president “wrong” advice.
---
“I think his advisers are wrong. I don’t know who — who is pushing him not to the right side,” Zelenskyy said. “This is not the right side of history.”

Together, we #ChooseDemocracy and unionized labor! | Farnham for Ukraine | | While our incompetent and corrupt U.S. President may have betrayed his agreement to help Ukraine by (allegedly) hampering its connectivity to Starlink, as Elon Musk blameshifts, I stand with President Zelenskyy and the Ukrainian people to defend themselves against Russian aggression. “Ukraine was blindsided by new limits placed on satellite connectivity inside the country that handicapped its ability to use military drones and defend against Russian attacks. After bipartisan backlash on Wednesday, Elon Musk said it was the U.S., not his company SpaceX that provides the systems, that made the call. The limits affected both the Starlink satellite connections, used for civilian and defensive activities, as well as Starshield, the version designed for government and military use for both defensive and offensive capabilities.” Furthermore, I support Ukraine’s recent attack on the Russian data center that may have compromised bots that were working in favor of conservative candidates ahead of the election. I hope Ukraine gets them all. Lastly, I support the increased sanctions against Russia by the European Union. “Today the EU adopted the largest round of sanctions listings since 2022. Close to 1600 listings target Russia’s military-industrial complex. Over half address the production chain for the ballistic missiles Russia uses to kill Ukrainian civilians every day. Bombing Kyiv’s bridges, ships transporting grain, and the National Academy of Sciences are not the actions of a country seeking peace. This is not the time to ease pressure on Moscow but to increase it.” Meanwhile, Trump has made a deal with Putin to buy deisel fuel from Russia. “Last week, Trump announced via social media he had struck a deal with Putin, whereby Russia will supply more than 300,000 tons of diesel to the American and global market, followed by an additional 500,000 tons in November and one million tons “immediately thereafter.”” Of course, our own U.S. Representative in Congress, out-of-touch John Joyce, silently approves of making deals with Putin in the face of Ukraine suffering. In 2024, Joyce even voted against a $60 billion military aid package for Ukraine that passed the House. But it doesn’t have to be this way. We can be represented in Congress by someone who actually cares about our allies and recognizes that Russia is an enemy at this time. Vote for me, Beth Farnham, on November 3rd, so we can stop this nonsense and be fully the ally for Ukraine we always were supposed to be. Together, we #ChooseDemocracy and actual allyship! Other source that I can’t link to: Elon Musk points finger at Trump over Ukrainian satellite restrictions There is bipartisan concern that Ukraine’s defense against Russian attacks has been hampered by the Trump administration ratcheting down the speed of its SpaceX-developed satellite system. 12, 2026 / 08:35 By Oct. 14, 2026, 7:54 PM EDT was blindsided by new limits placed on satellite connectivity inside the country that handicapped its ability to use military drones and defend against Russian attacks. After bipartisan backlash on Wednesday, Elon Musk said it was the U.S., not his company SpaceX that provides the systems, that made the call. The limits affected both the Starlink satellite connections, used for civilian and defensive activities, as well as Starshield, the version designed for government and military use for both defensive and offensive capabilities. On Tuesday night, Ukraine discovered that neither system could connect to data from objects — like satellite-controlled defensive and offensive drones — traveling more than 100 miles per hour, a source familiar with the actions told MS NOW on the condition of anonymity to discuss sensitive military operations. Serhii Beskrestnov, Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy’s defense technology adviser, that the speed limit for use of Starshield services “resulted in the disruption of several missions.” “It is clear that this action is not coincidental and is related to the current political situation,” Beskrestnov wrote. The Starshield connections are “critical for Ukraine’s defense,” Ukrainian Defense Minister Mykhailo Fedorov , saying the high-speed use was being restored. Musk said the Starshield satellite connections the Ukraine military relies on are ultimately controlled by President Donald Trump. “Starshield systems are owned and controlled by the US government,” Musk . “Any limits on speed or usage are decided by the US military and ultimately POTUS.” The White House, Pentagon and SpaceX did not respond to MS NOW’s requests for comment. SpaceX provided no prior warning to the Ukrainian government about the limitation, the source said. Ukrainian forces learned about the Starshield speed restrictions from customer support after filing a complaint about operational issues. SpaceX informed Ukrainian officials that the restriction applies to drones and aircraft flying at speeds of 100 mph or higher, but, the source said, military units also reported issues with performance at lower drone speeds. “This makes the operation of UAVs, airplanes and helicopters at high speeds impossible, which will also impact efforts to counter Shahed drones within Ukraine,” the source said, adding the speed restriction affects all defense operations and logistics, giving Russians “a real leverage on the frontline” at a time when Ukraine has effectively stopped their advances. Even Republicans had strong words for both Musk and the Trump administration. “I’m confident this does not reflect a change in SpaceX policy because if so, intentionally degrading Ukraine’s ability to defend itself might be construed as aiding and abetting a mass murderer,” Sen. Thom Tillis, R-S.C., , asking him to clarify SpaceX’s position. The timing of the Starshield changes coincides with Ukrainian officials saying the U.S. and allied partners have not been giving them the same amount of early warnings about incoming Russian ballistic missile attacks. Rep. Don Bacon, R-Neb., said Trump’s decision to reduce intelligence sharing with Ukraine and access to Starlink equated to “aiding the invader & the war criminal who bombs cities,” and threatens to reduce congressional support for the Trump administration. “Their agenda is dead unless they change paths,” Bacon . Ukraine Caucus Co-Chairs Reps. Marcy Kaptur, D-Ohio; Brian Fitzpatrick, R-Pa.; Mike Quigley, D-Ill.; and Joe Wilson, R-S.C., wrote in a bipartisan statement they were “alarmed” by reports of the U.S. withholding both intelligence and Starlink support, “putting innocent civilians and American citizens in Ukraine at the mercy of Russian attacks.” “U.S. allies pay for Ukraine’s access to Starlink,” the lawmakers wrote. “Restrictions that put civilians in harm’s way are unconscionable and will not be accepted by Congress.” The source familiar with Ukrainian forces’ use of Starshield confirmed to MS NOW that the signal was improving as of Wednesday afternoon, but only slightly. “The situation is better than before, but it is still not good enough, and the service has not returned to its previous level,” the source said. Ukraine is seeking to restore its unlimited access regardless of speed, which was part of the current service agreement contracted through the U.S. government. The agreement has been in place since November 2025 and is expected to remain in effect through May 2027. As SpaceX reduced Starshield connectivity for Ukraine overnight, Russia targeted critical energy infrastructure in the Kyiv and Kharkiv regions in a deadly ballistic missile strike. Earlier this week, Trump denied withholding intelligence essential for Ukraine’s defenses after multiple threats against Ukraine if it failed to halt attacks on Russian oil refineries — even as Russia has flouted the so-called energy ceasefire announced by the president. Rep. Jim Himes, the top Democrat on the House Intelligence Committee, said in a statement that the committee “has received no notification of any change in posture with respect to intelligence support to Ukraine.” Zelenskyy said in an interview Wednesday that he felt betrayed by Trump’s diesel deal with Russian President Vladimir Putin, announced last week, and that his immediate response was that Ukraine is “losing a strong partner” in America. “We can’t be weak, otherwise we can’t survive,” he told Piers Morgan. “That’s why it’s painful when President Trump chooses one side — not our side.” Zelenskyy criticized people around Trump for giving the president “wrong” advice. “I think his advisers are wrong. subject: Hope.
body:
When we feel hope, Greg Abbott feels fear.
# [](https://ginafortexas.com/?refcode=em_ms_gh_header)[](https://ginafortexas.com/?refcode=em_ms_gh_header)

**Voters head to the polls tomorrow, and we’ve never felt as much hope as we do right now, Peter.**
A year ago, almost no one thought Texas would be in play. The experts said Gina was the next Democrat lined up for a double-digit loss.
Now, six polls have shown her in the lead. The Houston Chronicle has endorsed her. More than 250,000 grassroots donors have chipped in. And the national press is writing headlines like the one above.
But when we feel hope, Greg Abbott feels fear. He’s already sounding the alarm to his billionaire friends, and he’s flooding the airwaves with attack ads against Gina. He still has $17 million to spend, and he’ll use every dollar to scare voters away from change.

I have a lot to share this week, including some concerns about the federal (so-called) "investigation" targeting Ilhan Omar (D-MN).
### **It never ends**
The world has been alarmed this weekend by Israeli settlers who [attacked](https://substack.com/redirect/1983869d-7ce7-43cc-aeaa-9c7e11b00031?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) a series of European diplomats, and nearly killed a Washington Post reporter who was [rescued](https://substack.com/redirect/9284acd8-ccd8-4054-9d2e-e35344b3415e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) by Palestinians.
Beyond the outrage we should all feel when journalists are [targeted](https://substack.com/redirect/4d0b2a08-0954-466e-90c5-70bccad54c80?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) to stop their reports from informing the public, I feel a particular connection to this story since I visited the West Bank in 2017 with Code Pink and Dr. Bronner's Magic Soaps to (quite literally) stand in solidarity with Palestinian farmers as they harvested their olives.
I wrote a bit about the trip--and more about the issues that I discovered--in formats including an electronic dance track titled "[Ferguson to Jerusalem](https://substack.com/redirect/bebd1a55-eaf1-4967-bbe7-3fbd5ddc96f2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)."
### **Passing through the bay**
I'm grateful to have found a vehicle through which to wage the class war outside of politics.
Since leaving San Francisco in 2022, I had been grateful to return only rarely, until my legal practice began accelerating over the past year. My clients today include tenants on all sides of the bay area challenging abusive (often corporate) landlords, and I'm grateful to have found a vehicle through which to wage the class war outside of politics. One set of clients who I help represent was [recently featured](https://substack.com/redirect/24625674-0006-476a-8940-88c7d17a0748?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) in the _San Francisco Chronicle_.
I'll also be back in San Francisco this Tuesday night for [a book talk by my sister](https://substack.com/redirect/c5f993cb-9f85-4f4e-82b5-0cb7fdc5c0b5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)! Her debut novel, _Daughters of Rosebud_ , is a multigenerational family saga set in the rural Missouri town where we first settled when our family immigrated to the U.S. in 1976. She'll be speaking at Bookshop West Portal on 10/20 from 7 to 8pm. The organizers request that attendees [please RSVP](https://substack.com/redirect/c5f993cb-9f85-4f4e-82b5-0cb7fdc5c0b5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
### **It was bad before**
Last week, federal agents [raided](https://substack.com/redirect/b1da087c-85ab-4560-838f-977e6fc43dbd?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) the home of a sitting Member of Congress, one who just happens to be among the president's most insightful and consistent critics. The timing of this so-called "investigation," just a few weeks before a major federal election, is suspect in itself.
Equally alarming is the stated goal of the raid: to reach back a generation, contrive some fraud in her family's immigration process, and [eventually deport her](https://substack.com/redirect/af1d2c0a-ccd5-407f-af7f-02d02766d5d4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
Even more alarming is the implicit message sent by the executive branch to everyone from legislative policymakers to their various constituents: [no one is safe](https://substack.com/redirect/1a36b38a-c976-443c-ac12-6943cb63aba1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) from weaponized government agencies in the United States--not even federal officials elected to oversee, check and balance them.
_Thanks for reading Chronicles of a Dying Empire! This post is free to share. Who in your network would most appreciate it?_
[ Share](https://substack.com/app-link/post?publication_id=1018597&post_id=221096763&utm_source=substack&utm_medium=email&utm_content=share&utm_campaign=email-share&action=share&triggerShare=true&isFreemail=true&r=1hvr60&token=eyJ1c2VyX2lkIjo5MDUwMTE5MiwicG9zdF9pZCI6MjIxMDk2NzYzLCJpYXQiOjE3OTIzOTAzMjAsImV4cCI6MTc5NDk4MjMyMCwiaXNzIjoicHViLTEwMTg1OTciLCJzdWIiOiJwb3N0LXJlYWN0aW9uIn0.1siDDGto1j9B_r9-Uy_wbCDb4KbAj48-Y9Qz_O3P_iA)
### **A unique figure in Washington**
Ilhan Omar is different from her colleagues in Congress.
Unlike most Members of Congress, she entered this world as a refugee before becoming a policymaker in the capital of the world's leading superpower. The Secretary of Homeland Security [claimed](https://substack.com/redirect/0c38df0e-7c70-4289-aab1-ec369b708ede?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) to be concerned about fraud in her family's immigration paperwork over a generation ago, but Omar has been the subject of any number of [outlandish disproven rumors](https://substack.com/redirect/a6ce1a9f-dc4e-4544-860e-b0af15eb623e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) in the past.
Unlike most Democrats (including those with [less deserved](https://substack.com/redirect/3edb837a-8bb0-48f4-bc2c-732b492d4e04?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) reputations as firebrands), Ilhan has [consistently](https://substack.com/redirect/3a776dd4-4288-4038-b097-79d64d9deeca?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) challenged the military industrial complex to which her colleagues routinely defer.
In a country long defined by its [enduring](https://substack.com/redirect/75f042c4-190e-47b0-8aef-984ae81ecdb4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) commitment to white supremacy, she is the first Somali-American, and the only African refugee, to ever serve in Congress. The independence of her policymaking reflects the unique background that she brings to the role.
That's among the reasons why every American--not just immigrants, not just policymakers, and not just Minnesotans--should be alarmed by what she's being forced to go through.
### **A unique place in America**
Rep. Omar's district is also different from many others.
It is the site of three different murders committed by government officials that sparked mass uprisings not only in the local region--but across the country and the entire world. George Floyd, [Renee Good](https://substack.com/redirect/4dd99bb1-b897-4237-9f02-f0e424d05853?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), and [Alex Pretti](https://substack.com/redirect/9a695f71-a3c4-4355-a897-48384643230f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) all lost their lives to corrupt and unaccountable government violence.
The city that sent Ilhan Omar to Washington is among the most consistent flashpoints for popular mobilization in the country, inspiring [solidarity actions](https://substack.com/redirect/9baa9d28-2bc7-4de0-bdad-9fe98b4652a4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) far & wide (in which, for full disclosure, I am grateful & proud to have [participated](https://substack.com/redirect/54e2945b-339a-44aa-a3a0-c1accb1cb0a0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)). That might offer one reason she has been targeted by the weaponized Justice Department.
Might that relate to the renowned reputation of Minnesotans as among the [nicest](https://substack.com/redirect/5d6c25c5-594a-4ee2-8715-52a953c14bd4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) Americans (which might also relate to its proximity to Canada, or perhaps an ironic legacy of having once hosted the [largest mass execution](https://substack.com/redirect/308e5aea-1db5-462c-9efe-c780cfb24f4e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) in U.S. history)?
Whatever its original inspiration, the kind of grassroots organizing that has made Minnesotans leaders among Americans is a reflection of not just the state's renowned politeness, but also discipline and determination. [Jesus would be proud](https://substack.com/redirect/404605ba-ceb3-42a2-ab46-6169499c9e32?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
That might explain why the president has [specifically singled out](https://substack.com/redirect/0018eae3-25f2-4549-9e74-f9d110357f46?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) Ilhan's district in his never-ending screeds demonizing immigrants. Having been born in a manger himself, and having famously exhorted his followers to "be kind to the stranger," one suspects that the person worshipped by Christians as the Son of God would be decidedly less enthusiastic about his followers enabling such vitriol targeting people who essentially stand in his shoes today.

### **Are you even serious right now?**
Earlier today, former President Barack [Obama chimed in](https://substack.com/redirect/917f7de8-98cf-46bf-b2c3-2efc63aaa1b5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) to defend Ilhan Omar.
Reading his words made my eyes roll so hard I almost saw the inside of my skull.
Obama [posted](https://substack.com/redirect/96e0bc33-5635-4244-919f-f13eec540ba1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) on Sunday morning to confirm that "the full weight of the federal government is being brought down on a law-abiding elected official because she has dared to criticize the president."
He went on to urge all Americans to recognize their interests, regardless of their political beliefs, writing: "if this becomes the new normal, there's no reason to believe it will stop with her--or that future presidents, in either party, won't do the same."
Reading his words made my eyes roll so hard I almost saw the inside of my skull.
On the one hand, I appreciate the former president's words. He's [absolutely right](https://substack.com/redirect/6b4a65d3-ebc6-42e1-9835-b67675decd1d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), after all.
But why does this stalwart defense of constitutional values emerge only a decade-and-a-half after he left office? Obama was no mere casual observer in the rise and bipartisan consolidation of ICE, or the concentration of power more generally in the executive branch.
He may have refrained from lying outright as much as the current occupant of the White House, but Obama's policies were nearly equally constitutionally offensive.
When his friend was profiled by a racist police officer, Obama [bought the cop a beer](https://substack.com/redirect/c5dfd7c0-145e-4594-968b-604df0aaaae5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) at the White House rather than support meaningful police reform in any way. This willingness to accommodate power at the cost of justice was the defining modus operandi of his presidency.
Obama cracked down [viciously](https://substack.com/redirect/6d19d155-e0d1-4a64-b662-2e9e0f14ddda?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) on the Occupy Movement, which was a product of popular frustration around the country with [his decision](https://substack.com/redirect/db6ed5c9-50be-4638-b2aa-4ee99b23997c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) to bail out banks in the 2008 financial crisis while [abandoning](https://substack.com/redirect/acb7b7a8-2282-4f42-8290-b86a744ce985?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) homeowners and renters.
He gave the CIA a [free pass](https://substack.com/redirect/9ea264ca-4bef-46d6-883a-a0808b55a461?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) for unrepentant human rights violations. He made the mass surveillance regime initiated by Bush an object of [bipartisan consensus](https://substack.com/redirect/57f332d9-2192-4272-b876-82b515f1b4f6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) while [vilifying](https://substack.com/redirect/f05a9ec0-cbe5-435f-b54b-53b2591cc32d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) the truthteller who [tried](https://substack.com/redirect/27d39e51-09a5-4360-a5d3-a4b962e2dc71?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) to inform America about he and his GOP predecessors tried to hide. He pioneered the presidential [power to kill](https://substack.com/redirect/d5497456-4720-4bef-9db8-e668736417b3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) with neither charge nor trial, which Trump used as the basis to stage a coup in Venezuela.
Obama [prosecuted](https://substack.com/redirect/aa9f3859-dcdc-477f-9a8e-5e8ea5326b6d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) more national security whistleblowers under the Espionage Act (essentially accusing them of being spies, rather than public servants risking their careers to do the right thing) than every preceding administration in U.S. history--[put together](https://substack.com/redirect/c145773b-7df6-4265-ba08-8f2fd5bc6e5b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
If Obama felt as strongly about civil liberties and constitutional legitimacy as he seemed to today, maybe he could have done something useful while he had his hand on the steering wheel, rather than defer to the same forces he now (finally) warns America to fear, decades after critically enabling them.
### **A lightning rod among Democrats**
Ilhan Omar is no stranger to controversy. For example, after [observing](https://substack.com/redirect/6867c32c-86b7-45b6-9277-809c226d3c64?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) how the 9-11 attacks have been opportunistically used by the Pentagon and bipartisan military-industrial complex to expand on their legendary corruption, she was subjected to [death threats](https://substack.com/redirect/9ea1d658-6217-4fb6-bb21-76481dfec0a7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)--and [not](https://substack.com/redirect/2084116e-41de-4519-826d-57212199c62b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) for the first time.
I publicly [defended](https://substack.com/redirect/fa58106d-a407-4d27-bcd1-73ea930addbf?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) Ilhan when the leader of her own congressional caucus chose to [demonize](https://substack.com/redirect/8b2b8cf1-b992-4433-be63-b5f8c6caf59b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) and [marginalize](https://substack.com/redirect/55087399-a677-48d5-a335-f2b8244b2db7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) her. It is revealing that when (then) Democratic Speaker of the House, Nancy Pelosi criticized Ilhan, she also went after [her supporters](https://substack.com/redirect/d38b28f4-23a7-4814-97e0-c2f60a07222e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
At the time, I publicly observed that Pelosi's attacks on Ilhan could have been [self-serving](https://substack.com/redirect/fa58106d-a407-4d27-bcd1-73ea930addbf?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), since she (and [much of Washington](https://substack.com/redirect/a7184333-e730-4470-9c53-f420d4b54bf0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)) could share international criminal liability for covering up CIA torture, and any number of further human rights abuses in which they remain complicit. As far as I know, no journalist ever demonstrated the independence to ask her whether that concern animated her attacks on a junior member of her caucus. But I digress...
I, too, am a naturalized immigrant. I, too, ran for office, though I was saved from the burden of service by the [racism](https://substack.com/redirect/949dda3b-ea78-4cfb-a30b-03e4e6d9ea82?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) of San Francisco's political writers.
I've grown increasingly grateful with every passing day that I dodged (or, more accurately, was forced away from) the bullet of my aspirations. Over the past half decade, my life has often felt like a dream come true: I DJ music festivals all summer, snowboard all winter, and write my articles and guide eco-history tours to continue the educational project to which I've dedicated my life, secure in the knowledge that I did everything one possibly could have (and a lot more than any single person conceivably could) to show solidarity with the future at a time when it might have mattered.
Seeing Ilhan Omar's experience this week leaves me triply grateful to live & work in the mountains, far from the nearest city. As much as I believe that the ideas we share could help the future, I'm happy to leave the project of arguing for those ideas to others who still have some hope or faith left in this country.
### **An attack on all of us**
But my relief at having dodged the bullet of public service does not diminish the constitutional significance of what Ilhan Omar is enduring at the moment.
[I]t is whatever vestiges of democracy this country still claims to represent that stand in the crosshairs.
On the so-called slippery slope on the way to full-blown authoritarianism, this is not a step down--but the equivalent of launching off a cliff.
It is another thing to fuse the private and public sectors so that [government answers to business](https://substack.com/redirect/f0bf46ea-6ee7-40d4-8ff0-279bc65f7a30?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), rather than the people.
It's another thing to lie to people for decades to [divide them in spite of their shared interests](https://substack.com/redirect/4fbc80c4-c3c3-48b6-b73b-5f95d2f97b96?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) and put them against each other rather than allow them to mount [joint resistance](https://substack.com/redirect/1dd7faaf-0bf1-49db-a77e-09791852a170?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) to the oppressor they all share.
It's another thing to silence [whistleblowers](https://substack.com/redirect/d0ff4937-d1ea-49b7-b4a3-e78743110185?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) and [criminalize](https://substack.com/redirect/361a71fc-feb4-47bd-98d3-26e0391c91db?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) their efforts to alert the public to issues their bosses would rather cover up.
It's another thing to [approve a mass surveillance regime](https://substack.com/redirect/25686944-a0cf-41d2-a9cb-023cf58d9a31?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) from the local to the federal level across the country answering in many cases to no oversight.
It is another thing to use [racially charged rhetoric to demonize minorities](https://substack.com/redirect/9ca20bf2-14c1-45fa-a7c1-dfc7b9d901e1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) in order to contrive sociopolitical support for a dominant group.
It is another thing to [deploy paramilitary goons](https://substack.com/redirect/4dd99bb1-b897-4237-9f02-f0e424d05853?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) across the United States to unaccountably murder peaceful people standing in solidarity with their vulnerable neighbors.
But criminally investigating and seizing the records of a political critic in the weeks before an election--to retaliate against their [advocacy](https://substack.com/redirect/b3aa3c07-a61b-45e0-8465-a16e18c1a009?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) on behalf of the victims of those murders--is a whole other degree of unconstitutional madness.
Ilhan Omar might be the person named in the search warrant approved by a magistrate judge and served by the FBI last week. But it is whatever vestiges of democracy this country still claims to represent that stand in the crosshairs.

---|---|---
### **What it means to be strong in public**
Undeterred, Ilhan [boldly](https://substack.com/redirect/3da44f46-0590-4716-99f6-60568496356e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)--and accurately--[wrote](https://substack.com/redirect/d3a1054e-be1a-4885-84a0-e2b2dee6cae9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) herself to explain the federal raid on her home: "Make no mistake: this is an attempt to target political enemies and weaponize federal law enforcement," while also characterizing the search and seizure of her belongings as "just the latest escalation in [the president's] campaign of political intimidation...."
Her lawyers succinctly explained why every American has a stake in her defense. They wrote [on Friday](https://substack.com/redirect/46ea9e4e-ad42-4e06-ab53-5098e6dee93d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), in a letter seeking the preservation of evidence, that "This vindictive, retributive, and politically motivated criminal investigation into one of the president's chief congressional critics violates Representative Omar's constitutional rights and threatens the separation of powers."
There's no question that the federal raid and contrived attempt to de-naturalize and deport Ilhan Omar is a crass and shameful episode in U.S. history.
The real question is: who's next?

Over the past half decade, my life has often felt like a dream come true: I DJ music festivals all summer, snowboard all winter, and write my articles and guide eco-history tours to continue the educational project to which I've dedicated my life, secure in the knowledge that I did everything one possibly could have (and a lot more than any single person conceivably could) to show solidarity with the future at a time when it might have mattered. name: Scott Wiener
subject: One question about data centers
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Scott WIENER FOR CONGRESS
body:
Quick question about what gets built in our neighborhoods. | |

Peter,

A company wants to build a data center in Dogpatch. I believe that site should be housing or mixed-use development – and I oppose the proposal.

San Francisco’s Board of Supervisors approved a 45-day pause on new data centers on October 6 so the city can evaluate and strengthen its rules. I support that pause.

But this debate reaches beyond one neighborhood. It’s about your utility bills, our water supply, and who gets to decide what gets built where we live.

**I want to hear from you: What concerns you most about data centers? Click one answer below.**
| | [HIGHER ELECTRIC BILLS](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/141699574/654480155/-1643397325?amount=3&express_lane=true&refcode=SW_EM_FR_180DO_261018_1_3&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS84MDY5OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIzNGZkNGVmZS04YWNiLWYxMTEtYmY1Yi0wMDIyNDgyOWY4NjkiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=cyVasv3lS6hODQf3d4byiOE2yu6biM20dz2lE7iJU9c=)

---
| [IMPACTS ON MY NEIGHBORHOOD](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/141699576/654480157/-1643397325?amount=10&express_lane=true&refcode=SW_EM_FR_180DO_261018_1_3&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS84MDY5OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIzNGZkNGVmZS04YWNiLWYxMTEtYmY1Yi0wMDIyNDgyOWY4NjkiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=cyVasv3lS6hODQf3d4byiOE2yu6biM20dz2lE7iJU9c=)
---
| [I’M NOT WORRIED](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/141699577/654480158/-1643397325?amount=25&express_lane=true&refcode=SW_EM_FR_180DO_261018_1_3&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS84MDY5OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIzNGZkNGVmZS04YWNiLWYxMTEtYmY1Yi0wMDIyNDgyOWY4NjkiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=cyVasv3lS6hODQf3d4byiOE2yu6biM20dz2lE7iJU9c=)
---

My position is straightforward: **Communities should get to choose whether they want a data center - and they shouldn’t have to shoulder the costs of data centers while giant tech companies keep the profits.**

That’s why I supported seven new California laws this year to:
* **Protect your utility bills** by requiring data centers to cover the costs they impose on the electrical system.
* **Protect our water supply** by requiring developers to disclose their water plans and pay for the new pipes, treatment, or storage they need.
* **Give communities more information and control** through energy and noise disclosures and stronger environmental review requirements.

These laws are an important step. As they take effect, we need to make sure they deliver for the people they’re supposed to protect.

**In Congress, I’ll fight to make sure tech companies pay their own way and communities have a voice in decisions that impact their lives.**

Thanks for weighing in.

Scott

subject: When you look up John Sununu’s name in the dictionary…
body:
[ https://act.chrispappas.org/go/126?t=1001&akid=9583%2E582294%2EejMog6 ]Chris Pappas for Senate[ https://act.chrispappas.org/go/126?t=1002&akid=9583%2E582294%2EejMog6 ]Chris Pappas for Senate

[ https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20261019_1.NTVAvu&refcode=em20261019-1&t=1003&akid=9583%2E582294%2EejMog6 ]Chris Pappas

I’ve spent my career listening to people across New Hampshire, and lately
I keep hearing the same thing: Washington has a corruption problem.

Politicians like John Sununu aren’t working for working families — they’re
working for the wealthy and well-connected.

Granite Staters have a right to be angry. Corruption is out in the open in
Washington. Donald Trump has added $2 billion to his net worth and traded
more stocks than every member of Congress combined.

And John Sununu is no different. When you look up corruption in the
dictionary, you’ll see a photo of Sununu.

Sununu went to Washington 25 years ago. And while he was there, he voted
on issues that mattered to Wall Street, Big Oil, and Big Pharma.

He voted FOUR times against lowering prescription drug prices. He sided
with the insurance industry, and he voted for a $700 billion Wall Street
bailout.

Then he was voted out of office and cashed in with those same industries,
making up to $35 million.

John Sununu walked right through Washington’s revolving door, and Granite
Staters are the ones who paid the costs.

There is only one candidate in this race who will bring a new generation
of leadership to the Senate, change the way Washington works, and deliver
for New Hampshire – not the special interests.

Public service should be about the people who sent you there, not about
cashing in. That’s the difference between John Sununu and me:

* I don’t take corporate PAC money. Not a dime.
* I support banning stock trading in Congress. I broke with my own
party’s leadership on this, because when you write the laws, you
shouldn’t be investing in the industries they affect.
* I’m fighting to get dark money out of politics. I introduced
legislation requiring big spenders to disclose who’s behind the money,
and I support overturning Citizens United.
* I’m working to close the revolving door in Washington. That includes a
lifetime lobbying ban for former members who work for foreign
governments.

There’s a reason John Sununu’s campaign is being propped up by the same
special interests he voted for while in Congress. They know that he will
continue to put Big Oil, Big Pharma, and Wall Street ahead of Granite
Staters.

New Hampshire needs a senator who will put working people and families
first, not side with corporate special interests.

But if we don’t match the millions in outside spending with grassroots
support, corporate special interests will buy this open Senate seat.

[ https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20261019_1.NTVAvu&refcode=em20261019-1&t=1004&akid=9583%2E582294%2EejMog6 ]Chip in $5 or whatever you can right now to help us
fight back. With 15 days left in this race, every dollar goes toward
reaching voters and spreading our message before the special interests
drown us out.

[ https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20261019_1.NTVAvu&amount=5&refcode=em20261019-1&t=1005&akid=9583%2E582294%2EejMog6 ]Donate $5 »

This race is close, and Election Day is coming fast. Every contribution
before then helps us get our message to voters in every corner of the
state.

[ https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20261019_1.NTVAvu&refcode=em20261019-1&t=1006&akid=9583%2E582294%2EejMog6 ]Rush a $5 contribution today to help us keep New
Hampshire blue and stand up against the GOP’s money machine.

[ https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20261019_1.NTVAvu&amount=5&refcode=em20261019-1&t=1025&akid=9583%2E582294%2EejMog6 ]Donate $5 »

This campaign is powered by grassroots supporters, not corporate PACs.
Thank you for standing with us. 15 days to go.

– Chris

| | Dear Fellow American, This officer was just convicted of manslaughter for trying to stop a fleeing criminal with non-lethal force. Sgt. Erik Duran dedicated 15 years of his life to the NYPD. He earned dozens of commendations. He helped take illegal guns off the streets. He put his life on the line to protect his community. **Now he's fighting for his own freedom** – [**and he needs your help.**](https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABl7ImQiOjUwMzQsInQiOjc2NywicyI6MTJ9AAwAAAAAA5vECXX1KowLUFD3sRw9t5cvbIGymV16WygYEz7JiJvRJqhiGPc1e4tjP3WY5RzlAuzpz-tvV1-sxoY0yyc6zmSYJPXdJNsq9AdB7VTL) All because of a split-second decision he made during a drug bust in the Bronx.
---
| | [](https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABl7ImQiOjUwMzQsInQiOjc2NywicyI6MTJ9AAwAAAAAA5vECXX37gNzkQ5UYlveLDyE9HwPkPa2GxmMamDP_SkkWWgjXb_6xzl7bblUhkcO0-XPec5yVS_RQv0T3XM3ynSCaLFv89vzIbniDCuu)

[ **Support Sgt. Duran** ](https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABl7ImQiOjUwMzQsInQiOjc2NywicyI6MTJ9AAwAAAAAA5vECXX4gH_K_pbeZXMKG3Dg68H6BOpeyM1_wV85-zICxLLW_WwBMV0F2X0HRk2c3FcRA1x0MJXxuYXdLdi6TY0XlVkvAyYnVehPK4bN)

| | | An undercover officer had just purchased narcotics from a suspect. As officers moved in to make the arrest, the suspect jumped on a motorized scooter and fled. Duran had only moments to react. He didn't reach for his firearm. He didn't use deadly force. **Instead, he grabbed a nearby cooler and threw it into the suspect's path to stop him.** The suspect crashed and later died from his injuries. Now, Sgt. Duran has been convicted of manslaughter and sentenced to prison. And he is fighting to clear his name through the appeals process. This appeal is his only chance to avoid spending the next 9 years behind bars with the very criminals he spent his career putting away. [**Will you help Sgt. Duran fight for his freedom?**](https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABl7ImQiOjUwMzQsInQiOjc2NywicyI6MTJ9AAwAAAAAA5vECXX6Bs3d9DKgSlWTaboTZY1ra6pWoOCy8EmdAZyAzBSlsSSq_SGbUQc9g5_cUq8Zxo2FcPOkSLYXt9xu_7ENAOBTnpwbDVzSLV93) The Law Enforcement Legal Defense Fund (LELDF) is standing with Sgt. Duran and helping fund his appeal. But legal battles like this are long, difficult, and incredibly expensive. And while Erik fights for his freedom, his wife and children are left carrying the burden alongside him. **They’re not only facing the reality of their husband and father spending the next 9 years in prison.** **Their own lives have been threatened because of this case.** That's why I’m asking for your help today. **[Please make a tax-deductible donation of $35, $50, $100, or more to help fund Sgt. Duran's appeal and give him the resources he needs to fight for his freedom.](https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABl7ImQiOjUwMzQsInQiOjc2NywicyI6MTJ9AAwAAAAAA5vECXX7qlyVlREBTCh7oUSCkHQrc49jlAQyfkwAyqKswtE2HRtiFxfChAeJXsJ79QIf5Y8ifUmfh_niAsE1LXizngXKKfOIdw2zFW5I)** **_Erik spent 15 years protecting others._** **_Now he needs people like you standing behind him.[Every donation makes a difference.](https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABl7ImQiOjUwMzQsInQiOjc2NywicyI6MTJ9AAwAAAAAA5vECXX820L39usWOoe128Xiq2xSNaYHhT4x_6sIJnQT2iqKUDm3lcU5ejUwu5WLH7ugikod3gZYa_MY2MItIZ1VpsFy9B2kingJlLqz)_** **_Thank you for standing with Sgt. Duran._** Sincerely,

Law Enforcement Legal Defense Fund**_

**Good Morning!** On this day in 1781, British Gen. Charles Cornwallis surrendered some 8,000 troops to George Washington at [Yorktown, Virginia](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLFurDAQAL_GdIfsxcBRuHgN3b02JVrO68OJD5_WGyz-PkryCelHM9K83ZYbxhT3x398kpOQl51qSSRCvGw5RY8nRg7IVDCtxIIrlgU0DBejL2Za8C7xoMVi410gAuoacmacwGoLo2021w09rQHMlfpJrwhE0zgY2_vrivcVfBPdt89oMxmtbde11ocrGRiGPtgR0CuryUfJ3L7nuMtGIZ35IG7v-dkkt4m8iur-KZgVzLXWdkWRRCFS8qXN_FAwJ0LeFcxMR06fEvOOfF4qsoL5Fy8K5jPzh-S6N-z8q8aUYhlGZfXjiTH95OSPlw4HXwEAAP__P-Z-sA), effectively ending the Revolutionary War. Cornwallis pleaded illness and skipped the ceremony, and when his deputy tried to hand his sword to the French commander, he was directed to Washington instead, who passed the honor to his own second-in-command. Holiday airfares are the [highest in at least a decade](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0cGOmzAQxvGnMTeQPXYgHDhQbagiNahdVdvtXtBgj2NvHUiNmyz79FXavMHO-a-Rfvp-HIYD-uCnY48napKdh4muS6CUKA5uDt7gij5ajLRgGCkmHHEZgEOZC56LekCd_IUGhZlpLBGQzKgRVQ2KK6hU5hpbSwUbGkHTVnMzVtYaUyJoTaWqbZn55vZPcFELzpWUhTJ2SwLKcmNVBWiY4mR8mmPxOvspObJhnS8UCz2fstC4lM4Lky2DjkGXIl4oFCu6eb4FDDob_NGlhUGHMXkdiEF3x-V3Xe58Wm6klTDmzh9dLiS_3XZTuHQKTH4a1pCYfGjh8duvr1Nx6J9-v7X7lu_fnvt1bv8Xf5h8-An1Ml57oVchX557_uX7fqc_1-_t-35npsfzS3vYaXh6bWW_ZrEx56sPwS9lxRQ_ntCHf7D0wT0uDfwNAAD__1Eants), with Thanksgiving fares up 31%. Today's poll asks whether you're flying anywhere this holiday season. The most important places in American history aren't where you think. On today's episode of _Flyover Focus_ , we count down 10 small towns that changed American history. [Tune in here!](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykz0Fq6zAQgOHTSLuY0VhPfl5oUSjZpdBVoRsxtkaximIFeRInty_tFXqA_4fv4xROlEtez290YS-phpX3rbAIt7DUkiM9KbdEjTcqEzehibaAgO5g4GDGQLPkOwdLOvrEjNxr9mYY0YLFwerFxzkiG4MwGyYHzo1uTABucthPAFZn__MzYEYDYPu-szH9Z4PO_Ut2QIrKAscstXVfNa-ycCrPeufWzfWii19ErpvqXxQeFR6f9Sa3bmKFR3m8Du8rPPbPXTcfr3suJW9uUBbOF8rlt5c_su8evwMAAP__b0RrrQ) Flying cars are getting closer to everyday life, and today's sponsor, [Doroni](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLuOnTAQQL_GdCC_LobCRaTV7TZtSmvA48tExka2YbV_H7GJ8gPbnjOaGZ1f7-4dKFJ6_YQdbQvZJfyoEVvD4rYcycMnUAlQsEJcsDRYoDrJ5dgL3ovZwdroQqeh8zYgSlQdWmFmqbmWRnebVZOZg0E18UmZdTYL18IAl2GZxGyk7Mje-wQXs-BcKzVoHyYUchwfQRsJnmmOnlouw-9MqW0Y4me-sAxr3rtot9aOytQPJp9MPildWNvgc8mJBso3Vc-z7a7ms6zI1BvuQJHJ8YY7ejp3pt4OIN8fUFrCUjc6_vkV9gPolb4m_ksx8V49lPvb4EzUwGklRy2U5g_eFeuPD4qR6miY5q_74Ne37ZuRLyv_BAAA___WoZBF), is giving investors a chance to get involved. ## Holiday Airfares Hit a 10-Year High
Flying for the holidays will cost more this year than at any point in at least a decade, [according to booking data](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0LHuozAMBvCngQ2UOAbKkOGWbr31RmTAaXIKDUosKt7-RFXpHuA_2YNlfb_vz2N6UIjh9fxNG1txaXrxu0QW4Tz5FMNKJ4XsKHOhOHMWmqlMoKBvtGr0ONEi4eAJqV6tYwY2NVs9jIAKYcDa265zC5tRDW5e0IFCZZZeo-HbDF1n5jrY659WetRKoTEtru7GGvq-czgArRUqXoOk3P5N4SWeXTzTwbld0lZH60X2UplfFdwruEumg2N7kk_pOqjgfpn-D8oSlsjX6tO-c24KnaX5mL7k5mtuNGKHIyC2XrZYZ7vu7xBjKP1QoXpuFOInhPywu8PCvwAAAP__b5uDAw) from Hopper. The average domestic round trip is running 31% higher than last year for Thanksgiving and 23% higher for Christmas. That works out to about [$402 for Thanksgiving and $452 for Christmas](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLFutDAQhJ_GdCB7beCncPE3dJc2JVrby7GRwci2uNzbR7nkDdKPZub73m_LDTnycX_DnWxd03LQo0SqlfKypcgBn8h5xUwFo6Nc0WFZQMLQKtmqaUFf-aLFYBPsSgSkG7JqnMBIA6NpNuud9l47P6Dr0fgweudGj0pq1Q9Tjw3b7z4l1aSkNFp3Jqz_SMEw9KsZAYMwkgLXlLuPxEfdaI3PdFHufNqbaLdazyL0fwGzgHmnwNht6Tx_AgLmTIUw-03A_Hr-C9bWjBfFlo9An0224XxwjFyGURh535Hja6D-0ctl4SsAAP__QUl4nw), driven by jet fuel costs tied to the Iran war and travelers booking earlier than usual. International fares are up too, with the biggest jumps to Europe, Mexico, and the Caribbean. The day matters as much as the destination. Returning the [Sunday after Thanksgiving](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0LGSpCAQxvGn0QwLkFEJCC4xm0svtFpopG9RpoDSnbffmqndJ9i8q-v_-_7dlztQpGP7Czua6tNy4FUi1op5CSmSgydQ9pCxQFwxV1ihLJLLgQnOhF7AVjpxUdA64xEl9i0aMWqpuJKjaoOx2g_a96MS_SonPd4mqZW11sK4rqueWjKvf4ILLThXfd8p5ycUchhuXo0SXKM4Oqopd_8THTWgj890Yu5s2ttoQq2P0vR_Gjk3cr6uq4t04pEunz5fJ42cX6pGzu_ubxarGU6MrAY4PspGJx0bsyFTqTsU9qNmGcEGFmgLWCp7ZLJYmEMLDtts3OOiGKkMY6P4tgPFd1T95ZankV8BAAD__8xEjGQ) runs over $600, while Thanksgiving Day itself and Black Friday are the cheap seats. The weekend before Christmas is the priciest departure window. Hopper's advice is to [book before Halloween](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkDHOozAQhU9jOiN7MBAKF9vQZdst0YDH8UQOjmwvKLdfscoN_maakb73vvfnvtyRI--P3_giW31adjpLpFopLyFFdvhBzh4zFYwr5YorlgUUDFIrqacFt8oHLQYbZz0RUNeQ1eMERhkYTRMs9r0CPyAaWjVt2-hM33c3hGGaNph0w_biaaUnrZTputY4fyMNw9B7MwI6YRQ5rim3z8R7DeTjJx2U2y29mmhDre8iul8CZgHzeZ6tT3mlcr0FzIUrFQHzk2MsW-DoQvpbSMB8xQqYtboOCJi_xvKrLLlIrBIv1Q9hloEfQQbKVGRIp6wZD4qUi9xwl6VyjLLgcaGbbN375Bi5DKMw6vFCjv_71h_OfFj4FwAA__-LUZIV). Christmas hotel rates are up 18% as well, averaging $197 a night.
## 4 Soldiers Killed in Alberta Base Fire
Four Canadian soldiers died and 39 were hospitalized, at least 19 in critical condition, when a "violent, fast-moving" grass fire swept a [training range](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0LFyqzAQheGnEZ2Z1SILU6i4DZ1vm5JZpJXZRFiOUEz89hnyCulO9c2c_-06XUmS3G__aWVXY57uvG-Ja-UyLTlJoBdJiVR4ozRzqTTTNiGgPWk46WEiX-XJk6EmuMiM3DXsdD-gAYO9aRY3gNZnsBpDmHV3RgSKni7Rmg7JW2jEHZ4GPWgA03WtCfHCGq09R9MjBWWAg9Rc2vcs97pwTK_85NL6vDbJLbU-NtX9UzgqHPd9b-fZtz63Xx8Kx-OQwpFKFZ_4mH69cSqfl-8BQ26KC49dUpLN9srAbSVJv3D9Y4-nw58AAAD__yqqdEQ) at Canadian Forces Base Wainwright, Alberta, on Saturday. Prime Minister Mark Carney called it one of the worst peacetime tragedies in the military's history on home soil. Soldiers were throwing live grenades and running attack drills when a fire more than half a mile away shifted with [gusts near 62 mph](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLFuwyAURb_G3ogemEAYGLpkS9eO1gMe8auwHWEUy39fueofdLy60tU95-sxPpALL89PnMm3vI4L7Vuh1qiO01o44YFcM1basASqDQNuowJlhAQh3Yix8ZtGjX3ymUjR0JOX1ikNWlndTx6cA0zBGJNDDDEPTloDKka4hShR9-zPPQnSSQA9DBed8o2kMuaatVWYOg2UuK318r3y0ibK5VjfVC9xnfvip9ZeWzd8dOreqTu-ToSzOkNtHAt16h5xwYTiD0LMXLhhPUTAjUTmSmJHXvbKz6kJiVrenEt4DYasswEAwMiMOqGLBvvq02vnUngzttPwnJHL75v2T4lvr34CAAD__8CIhpE) and reached the range's administrative area in under a minute. Maj. Gen. Wade Rutland said it's "not normal" for a fire to move that far in 30 to 60 seconds. Officials said there was [no sign of outside interference](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkDGu5CAQRE-DMyxos2YcEGzibDbd0GpMM-4VtkeABvn2K3_9G_yspJJK9d7f5_JETny8_uBOrsZzOaiVRLVSXrYzccALOUfMVDB5yhU9lgUUjFIrqacF18ofWgx2wUUioKEjp-0ERhmwpttc1P5hp4Bo0NLDR9DWAwSFYVgtjtixu_e00pNWygxDb0J8kIZx_BWNBQzCKApcz9z_O_moG8V0nR_K_XruXXJbre8iht8CZgFza61ffbk57l7AfEcBcyAM6ZJ8rBzoqDJyJvkNJVc8MKDcOXHFfEmPheQavWzIR8v82qqAucsuvBunxGW0wqjXjpy-XtQfyvs4-B8AAP__LtWG7A) and that no oil or gas infrastructure was involved, despite reports of explosions. The four were all with [3rd Battalion, Princess Patricia's Canadian Light Infantry](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0LFugzAQxvGnMVuQfTgYBg9d2NK1Izrjc7jKxJGxcNKnr-grdP6kn_T9v27zDTny4_6JG9kS0vygukcqhfK8psge38g5YKYdo6Nc0OE-g4T-ouRFjTMuhQ-aNTbeBiKgriGrzAhaajC6WW3QPRkPix-dGsgHb0bnvUG6mlEGpxu2p6ekGpWUuuta7cNACvr-GrQB9EJL8lxSbr8TP8pKIb7TQbld0tZEu5by3EX3IWASMNVaW-eWcxMwnXcETJEPEjAt2wsGY-rwqj-lydY_K8fIe2-ElvcNOf6R5Z8lDgu_AQAA__-4fHNV), based in Edmonton and preparing for a deployment to Latvia. ## France Erupts in Riots, Unrest Spreads in EU

| A few days ago at National Night Out in Danville, Virginia, I told a little boy that Jesus loves him more than he could possibly imagine and that God has a very important purpose for his life. Right after that, a woman named Kayla Robinson heard what I said, walked up, gave me a big hug, and prayed over me. She shared her incredible story and invited me to church. Kayla is a police officer who was shot six times in Danville a couple of years ago. She got back up, returned fire, and later showed me where her keychain stopped a bullet that would have killed her. Absolute miracle.
Kayla has been awarded three law enforcement valor medals and a Purple Heart.
There is a link to her amazing story below.
This weekend I went to Sunday school and church with her. That makes 412 different churches I've worshipped at in my district. My wife and I go to our church early, and then I sometimes go to a second or even a third church. I've been doing this since 2017.
Afterward we had lunch and met some great people, stopped by a car show and met more great people, and then visited the Danville Registrar's Office where she voted. We would not have a country without our amazing men and women in law enforcement. Thank you, Kayla, and everyone like you who keeps us safe.
Don't forget you can vote early, the last day is November 3.
God bless you, and God bless America. Virginia law already required a judge's approval and included strong safeguards. These cases were rare. I did not believe Richmond politicians should override the judgment of parents and judges in those limited situations. Forty-two other lawmakers also voted no for the same reason.

The most important places in American history aren't where you think. Some of the moments that shaped this country happened in towns with one stoplight, a single gas station, and a tumbleweed rolling across Main Street. Do you ever wonder where the Cold War got its name? Which town spent three years officially not existing while it helped win a world war? Or where the most famous invention in American history finally got off the ground? One of these towns could be in your state, and you may have even driven through it without knowing what happened there. On today's episode of _Flyover Focus_ , we count down 10 small towns that changed American history. [Tune in here!](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykj7GK6zAQRb_G6mKkiWxFhYoHj3RZ2GphGzG2RolAtoI1sZ2_X7y_sO2Few7n6-ZvmHKa7x84keM9Fj_TVjMx0-InrDWtNOFcU5lrLEvFTEy7Bwn9ScmTsh5HTit5jSK4QQarBDllLGhpDEjxcEGP8QKIg-o7bS10yiqlTeiNvoDupEjuwCl57FJ1l3ZEPMMQobfBoIqh0ZJC4rK0_Dj0WGN-l5WWdiyTyO7B_KzN-V8D1wau7_LiVztQA1fe_5vPWe7b9yYWF55byjnV3jRa3idM-ffPf-1eHfwEAAD__6w9bTc) Today's sponsor, [Particle](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkMEOnCAQhp8GbxpAVuXAocnG2_baIxlhcElBDLC6ffvGzfYJep3_n2_yza-HfoAPflt_QkRV3y7pDc8SsFbMOkIp_sAIW_FpKy7lAgErvjWnfGgZbZnUYKo_UAtorFqolaxBxUbJBR1HTpunGrl0bJHDgMIN8mYFt9PEFzEZIR3SsfHqwjHKJGOU3abOAPR8cXyQdgTmLBEUra8pd_V5nYfiwp90YO5Mik1Qz1r3QvofhM-Ez-d5djvk6k1Al3LE7aoRPocdViR8_he2Dgy2JiPEFkP7ZV6Qfn7VqEt6ZYOkv38THcFvpULFHczvD2u4ehGtf0XS33fw9jszEHfw63ZtG51MvV2OTVZ2P30IvgwjEXSN4MNHov7v8w_F_wYAAP__Sy6eJw), makes a 6-in-1 face cream specifically for men designed to target common signs of aging, including eye bags, dark spots, wrinkles, dryness, and loss of firmness.

## Airman Dies in Alamodome Fall
An Air Force service member died Saturday after [falling while rappelling](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkLGOpDAQRL8GMiPbMHAOHFxCNpdeiBq7PbRkbGT3wOzfr9hf2LxUVe_9fy5PoEjp9Q92tPwJeUl41YjMWJYdaqUTd0iVcqohlwoRGT-LlnoUSgplFnBMJy4DtN6u0hvVolWT0YOcJi3bzTpwuA4TeGdcb5TuEeGh1scK6DFM0JK965RURimpHn86B9DrNejR-AlU8M0g0RPn0vF2z0MN8SufWDqX9zbajfmoTf-30XOj5-u6upA_etzyu3JOd6jR883V6BmoiJCLQ1EPdASRKgtPWAUExiIKHAfGW4kIEKN4s6iQBCTOibJ4wY5tsf64KEaq49QM8rUDxZ8r_FuFp9XfAQAA___o64vj) from the Alamodome rafters before UTSA's football game against Navy, with more than 23,000 fans in the stands. He was one of four service members set to [descend from the ceiling](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkbGynDAMRb_GdN6xxLIsBUUaupc2JSNAXjSxMWNr4W2-PkN-IY0qSWfOvb--xi-SINvrJ0Xu9dunceOzBFblPEYqRQ6OtBVJW_EpFwqs_D2iw4cFZ6EbaVY5eLxTtfSTWzqouIe2w7trW3TV2jddh8_aNwBNAx4erp6nGqamI3ATQ1tJf70DBx2Ag-Z5m4lqnDw-uqUl8Iu5O15EU77peuGp-PBJB-fbnGIV-lV1L6b-YXAwOJzneZuDzL9xTe-iabu2DA6XmMEhpJmCweFiGhzAXeNpcIgSRCl_bOF8yMw2cpw42zWVXZSC_OHFklfO1lMIdnln2V42075zuDK0C8e0Fc2kkjZLat9ayPqUdLoOXhTZ4FDlftlPCUHKozV394ok4Z-J_m8DR49_AwAA__9noZ7F) during UTSA's Salute to Armed Forces and Veterans night. Witnesses said he came down fast as the band began playing, and the crowd fell silent. The rappellers came from an Air Force detachment that [trains tactical air control](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkL3SpCAURJ8GMy24omhAsInZbLqhdcXLSBU_FrA68_Zb7it8eVd3n_Pntb7QeRffvzGQrh-b1kh38VQr5TVgKe6igLG4FItNuaCnSp8VOIyt4K2YVzTVXbRKbHa98X0WDWmhZpBcKeDNobdeWiVUD6PBebP9JJSZByO5ssPWb1Pj9FMnuJiF4GKYOoPYw2ZhnHeFwu5MctpdTbmrxzOPxfpvuih3JoXG66PWs7D-F4OFwXLfdxe-BSPGmqJLT4jB8nAxWHwy6BksmKsznhgshfLlDLWBwka5teh9af_Wgu0bA7UAcgI5QHceZ5P1ft7Oe1dGxSR_B3T-_4n6U3mXhn8BAAD__xOLhhI) party airmen at Joint Base San Antonio-Lackland and JBSA-Camp Bullis. Officials at Nellis Air Force Base in Nevada said the airman [died at a local hospital](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkL2u4yAQRp8Gd0Qw_iEUFNu4y7ZbWmN7sJHAWDBxkrdf5b7CrT_pO0fn32N6YIjh2P5iIsdvn6eDXjUSM5UpYa3hooRHDfmoPpeKkZjeEygYpFZS2wkXDhdNHTarm9VqdUNOGwudMgZUszvoh7ZVd2t6NcwGrZ21ATKz6sxCvvdNcN87rbTVWun-flsQW5g9DHY1qP0qOkVr4FxuvH_xWH385IvKbcmpiW5nPqto_wgYBYw4L7r9LgLGyrl8BIwpxMBYPjJRmqnI_VlYeoxRFvRMpcr1WcKxySdXlGehDRPJgudJUcCore2VNZ2AsSluPV8hxlAHIzq1JQzxx4N_2-9y8D8AAP__8KiGWQ) and haven't released his name. The death is under investigation. The game kicked off after a 10-minute delay.
## Sarkisian: Everything Will Be Evaluated
Texas coach Steve Sarkisian [wouldn't rule out](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkD2u4zAMhE9jdwwk-Udx4WKbdG_bLQ3GomMishSIjJ3cfpFc4ZXkADPfzL-f6Qc5crr9xY1GfS15SnRIJFUq04YivNOGSTgnWXIRjKT0mpxxPVgDdphwVt5parEO49WEwdY0Wj-41njvTL2OM5rGU0fduV0a8ti3Xd-6c-gab5xvrjWPHztr7GCtsd35NCM27rq4fgge7RKq1lBgzeWk6yceZYnvvFM5zXmr47iqPqRq_lTuUrnLcRynJb8-PT565S75qXee7yCPXFQqdxGlnUCw3FkYE-z5EKAd4xOVgHYqb1053eDISaE8I0F-Klwpzd83lnmFDVP6HhsH-FKBHhluuBHInUNdxvA4OEaW3letuW3I8Uusv116H93_AAAA___oKZm1) benching quarterback Arch Manning after Saturday's 27-24 home loss to unranked Florida, saying, "Everything's going to be evaluated." Florida, starting its backup quarterback, [sacked Manning five times](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJyk0L2unTAQBOCnMR3Iu_wYChdp3N20KdGCF7C04CPbgXvePjr3FVKP9M1o_nzNXxQkXPtvOtmW7y3OFz9ZuBRO80k5h5tPunKIV95iyiRc-HtGjUMNuoZpprWEm-eOKm8X7Seo2IKZsNPGoK4OOwL2uLZL1xoY-mGEzkBv1ha7fmp71lWwHw40TAAa-rFZiVpcNhwmbwg2rzrNPpSYmnJ86ilv8o43p2aNZyX2KOWVVftLoVPonudpOL-uT6jQrVGEd663GMtCIgpdLjG9FbpZoQteoes16hb0qND98DXfJH-pcM03p3c5wrXXEnOuN4kpeKqS9a8niIQ8GNXp_aQgP2vK_754W_wXAAD__8AAh4o) and recovered his fumble with 1:58 left to seal the upset. Manning, who threw for 173 yards, said "everyone's evaluated every week" at a school like Texas. The slide began a week earlier, when Manning threw two [fourth-quarter interceptions](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkDGu2zAQRE9DdWuQtGxZhQqnUPeDdEEqYSkuTSIU6XA30s_tA_sKvxtggDeD9_Nj-cCUU3l8x40m-Qx1KXRwJhFqy4bMaacNC6daONTGmEnoc7HaXsFoMOOCq6Sdlh47PzntR9PRZIbR9noYrO7ipA1h787Dai7DdTB4ceFGNxMubnXae9Ol6YUz2ozGaHO5nVbEs3XBXkc_oAle9Zp8ktpOEl_zyCH_qzu101q3Lk9R5MnqfFd2VnY-juO0cXl1ys5U4C8rO_OzNnmFUKs4zFnZ-Y2CuAIL7QSM7XfihAViKsIQCRjqkwpIBUdljak84I8DbGuEDUtJ5aHsjA3ud0vy68e3rk3-eaScE18H1evHhim_X8pX7e6T_R8AAP__03CSzQ) in a loss to Oklahoma that cost Texas its No. 1 ranking. Sarkisian, who also calls the plays, spread the blame after the Florida loss: "_Was Arch perfect? No. But nobody was perfect on offense today_." Should Sarkisian turn to K.J. Lacey at quarterback, Manning would likely spend another year in college, [possibly at another school](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykULvSnCAUfhrscABdXQuKNHabNqVzkIMyy8WBs7p5-4x5hb_-7t-f1_ICH3zafkNETV-Xl4RXDUiEZYlQqz8xQqo-p-pyqRCQ8LsooQYuBZfTAiv5E5ceGquNsJNsUMtxUr0YRyWaXRv7XGHoECY7gnmMtgMDnUDnYFLSysbr204KOUkp5OPZrgCdMk4Nt0I6y3qB1lMuLe13PFQX_uYTS7vm2AS9Ex2Vdb-Ympmar-tqk1nrkQvVm8HUnFxgaj5KdjmTgRAIwpupuXxiLjz6cMP3cqbmSngir1DevnpI3GasiXj5BOT5Q9xgWnefNg5l3XmElHzamqLtcfkQfB1G1ostgg__69FPbz21-hcAAP__3pCTGw), a detour for Peyton and Eli's nephew, recently the betting favorite to go first in the 2027 NFL Draft.
